body: GE Aerospace has qualified NYCO's TURBONYCOIL® 600 turbine oil for its GEnx-1B engines, mounted on Boeing 787 aircraft. The qualification marks the culmination of several years of close collaboration with Air France, which conducted an in-flight evaluation campaign of TURBONYCOIL® 600 across multiple engines over a period of more than 36 months.

Oil analyses performed throughout the evaluation campaign demonstrated the thermal stability of TURBONYCOIL® 600 and the performance of its antioxidant and anti-wear additive package. Following nearly 7,000 flight hours, engine teardowns and inspections confirmed effective wear protection of lubricated components and low levels of coke deposition. These results led GE Aerospace to qualify TURBONYCOIL® 600 for use in the GEnx-1B engine.

“The qualification of TURBONYCOIL® 600 for the GEnx-1B engines is an important step in NYCO’s expansion in the civil aviation sector. Building on 40 years of in-service experience and thanks to a continuous partnership with Air France, TURBONYCOIL® 600 once again demonstrates its high standards of quality and performance.” Paul Gallais, Business Development & Marketing Director, NYCO, said the qualification was an important step in NYCO’s civil aviation expansion.
en.summary: GE Aerospace has qualified NYCO's TURBONYCOIL 600 turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines powering Boeing 787 aircraft, following an Air France in-flight evaluation of more than 36 months and nearly 7,000 flight hours.
en.title: GE Aerospace qualifies NYCO turbine oil for GEnx-1B engines after Air France trials

body: GE航太已核准NYCO的TURBONYCOIL600渦輪油用於GEnx-1B發動機，該型發動機裝於波音787客機。這項核准是與法航多年密切合作的成果；法航以多具發動機進行空中評估，歷時逾36個月。
評估期間的油品分析顯示，TURBONYCOIL600具備熱穩定性，其抗氧化與抗磨耗添加劑組合亦表現良好。累積近7000飛行小時後，發動機拆解與檢查證實受潤滑組件獲得有效磨損防護，且積碳沉積量低；這些結果促使GE航太核准該油品用於GEnx-1B發動機。
NYCO業務發展與行銷總監表示，這項核准是NYCO拓展民航業務的重要一步；該油品憑藉40年使用經驗與法航的持續合作，再次展現其品質與性能水準。
zh.summary: GE航太已核准NYCO的TURBONYCOIL600渦輪油用於GEnx-1B發動機；法航以多具發動機進行逾36個月、近7000飛行小時的空中評估後，拆解檢查證實其磨損防護效果。
zh.title: GE核准NYCO渦輪油用於787發動機　法航逾36個月試飛完成驗證
